health-check.name: health-check
health-check.description: Internal health check. Verifies MTProto connectivity and reports link status.

auth-status.name: auth-status
auth-status.description: Check the Telegram connection status: whether the account is linked, who is signed in, and whether real-time event forwarding is active.

auth-send-code.name: auth-send-code
auth-send-code.description: Step 1 of linking a Telegram account: request a login code for the given phone number. Telegram sends the code to the user's Telegram app (or SMS). Then call auth-sign-in with the code the user provides. If the account has 2FA enabled, auth-sign-in will also ask for the password.

params.phoneNumber: Phone number in international format, e.g. "+34612345678"

auth-sign-in.name: auth-sign-in
auth-sign-in.description: Step 2 of linking a Telegram account: complete sign-in with the code the user received (from auth-send-code). If the account has two-factor authentication enabled, pass the 2FA password too. On success the session is persisted and the account is linked.

params.code: The login code the user received in Telegram (or by SMS)
params.password: Two-factor authentication password (only if the account has 2FA enabled)

auth-disconnect.name: auth-disconnect
auth-disconnect.description: Disconnect the linked Telegram account: logs out from Telegram (invalidating the session on Telegram's side), wipes the persisted session, and stops real-time event forwarding.

list-chats.name: list-chats
list-chats.description: List the user's Telegram conversations (dialogs): private chats, groups, supergroups and channels, most-recent first. Returns chat IDs usable with the other tools.

params.archived: List archived conversations instead of the main list (default: false)

get-chat-history.name: get-chat-history
get-chat-history.description: Read message history from any Telegram chat (private, group, supergroup or channel). Returns newest-first by default with pagination support.

params.chat: Chat identifier: chat ID from list-chats (e.g. "-1001234567890" or "5612345678"), @username, or t.me link
params.offsetId: Return messages older than this message ID (for pagination — use the oldest ID of the previous page)
params.minId: Return only messages newer than this message ID
params.fromUser: Only messages from this user (@username or user ID)

search-messages.name: search-messages
search-messages.description: Search the user's Telegram messages. Two modes: global search across all conversations (default), or scoped search inside one chat (pass `chat`).

params.chat: Optional: limit the search to this chat (chat ID, @username or t.me link). Without it, searches all conversations.
params.fromUser: Only messages from this user (only valid with `chat`)

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Send a text message to a Telegram chat (private chat, group, supergroup or channel). Supports replying to a specific message and disabling the link preview.

params.chat: Destination: chat ID from list-chats, @username, or t.me link
params.text: Message text (max 4096 characters). Markdown formatting (**bold**, __italic__, `code`) is parsed by default.
params.parseMarkdown: Parse Markdown formatting in the text (default: true). Set false to send raw text.

send-media.name: send-media
send-media.description: Send a file (image, video, audio or document) to a Telegram chat. Reads the file from a local path inside the container — use /workspace/... for files in the user's workspace volume, or a public HTTPS URL.

params.chat: Destination: chat ID from list-chats, @username, or t.me link
params.file: Local file path (e.g. "/workspace/report.pdf") or public HTTPS URL
params.caption: Optional caption shown with the media (max 1024 characters)
params.asDocument: Send as a plain document instead of auto-detecting image/video/audio type (default: false)
params.asVoiceNote: Send an audio file as a voice note (default: false)

download-media.name: download-media
download-media.description: Download the media attached to a Telegram message (photo, video, audio, document, sticker...) and save it to a local path. Use /workspace/... to save into the user's workspace so other tools and agents can access the file.

params.chat: Chat where the message lives: chat ID, @username or t.me link
params.messageId: ID of the message with the media (from get-chat-history or an event)
params.outputPath: Local path to save the file (e.g. "/workspace/photo.jpg"). Defaults to /workspace/telegram-media/<messageId>.<ext>
params.thumb: Download only the thumbnail instead of the full media (default: false)

edit-message.name: edit-message
edit-message.description: Edit a message sent by the linked account. Telegram only allows editing your own messages (in channels, within 48h; in private chats/groups, within 48h unless the chat has longer edit windows).

params.chat: Chat where the message lives: chat ID, @username or t.me link
params.messageId: ID of the message to edit

delete-messages.name: delete-messages
delete-messages.description: Delete one or more messages in a chat. With revoke=true (default) the messages are deleted for EVERYONE in the chat; with revoke=false they are only deleted for the linked account. Deleting other people's messages requires admin rights in groups/channels.

params.chat: Chat where the messages live: chat ID, @username or t.me link
params.messageIds: IDs of the messages to delete (one or more)
params.revoke: Delete for everyone (default: true). false = only delete for yourself.

create-group.name: create-group
create-group.description: Create a new Telegram group or channel. kind="group" creates a small group chat with the given members; kind="supergroup" creates a large group; kind="channel" creates a broadcast channel. Returns the new chat's ID for use with the other tools.

params.title: Name of the group or channel
params.members: Usernames or user IDs to add as initial members (@username or numeric ID). Required for kind="group" (at least 1 besides you); optional for supergroups/channels.

manage-members.name: manage-members
manage-members.description: Manage members of a Telegram group/supergroup/channel: list members, add (invite) a user, remove/kick a user, or ban/unban a user. Listing requires the account to have access to the member list; kick/ban require admin rights.

params.chat: Group/supergroup/channel: chat ID, @username or t.me link
params.user: Target user: @username or user ID (required for add/remove/ban/unban)
params.limit: For action="list": max members to return (default: 50, max: 200)

mark-as-read.name: mark-as-read
mark-as-read.description: Mark messages in a Telegram chat as read (clears the unread counter and mention badge).

params.chat: Chat to mark as read: chat ID, @username or t.me link
params.maxId: Mark messages up to this ID as read (default: all current messages)

name: Telegram
description: Full Telegram integration via MTProto (teleproto). Connect your personal account to read chats and history, send messages and media, manage groups and members, and receive real-time message events.

changelog.notes: Real-time event forwarding is now native: telegram.message.received/edited/deleted are emitted automatically at boot when the account is linked (no tool call needed). Removed the manual events-start/events-status tools.
Initial release — connect your Telegram account, read chats and history, send messages and media, manage groups and members, and receive real-time message events
